Definition: Shual, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Shual = "jackal"; n pr m; 1) as Asherite, son of Zophah; n pr loc; 2) a district in Benjamin probably north of Michmash
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
